title: Characterization of a kth-smallest value
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $l$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $y\in\alpha$. The value $y$ is a kth-smallest value of $l$ if and only if $y$ occurs in $l$, fewer than $k$ entries of $l$ are strictly less than $y$, and at least $k$ entries are less than or equal to $y$.
